body:
Owned-endpoint reuse is implemented; its applicable final integrated qualification and practical-performance obligations remain open.

Current product/scientific source is committed and pushed at [4bcd987](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/4bcd9875cd9308deabed06a5fa2f17d2321b0cbc) on `development/retained-dense-step-control-2026-10-06`, the head of [draft PR #62](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/pull/62). Main remains `5e706073a3fd2f9afcf8efbcde2f094122050f6a`. No further CPU endpoint-ownership defect has been established by the recorded reviews.

Original discrepancy: `src/sirius/core/geodesic_integrator.cpp`, `IntegrateStepRk45Candidate`, re-evaluated geometry at the final accepted position through `CalculateAcceleration` even though stage seven already owned that endpoint's geometry. In `KerrSchildFamily`, separate `Evaluate` and `InverseMetric` calls repeat first-order metric/derivative work. The full candidate and two independent half-candidates repeated those queries. An earlier slow writer observation identified the review target; it did not establish this work's share of frame time.

Repair retained from [f766bed](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/f766bed00ac81983d680296610c79ab6b6d1e032): reuse precisely the accepted candidate's stage-seven sample, convert its inverse/derivatives through the existing `Rounded` values, and retain the original binary64 contraction order and final projected tangent. Keep public `CalculateAcceleration` for callers without an owned sample. Preserve all physical, embedded, independent-half-step, dense/interior and rollback checks. The later accepted dense controller caps only next-step growth after original admission; embedded shrinking and rejection-driven halving remain intact.

Evidence and its bounds:

- The original ownership/word regression detects the redundant queries and passes the repair. At [b34d8c2](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/b34d8c25ec33891bafbb264e6e483de9362e2286), all 53 original CPU numerical cases, four coupled sanitizer controls, the moving detector serial/parallel control and both original 64×64/four-SPP writer cases pass with unchanged assertions. All PNG/EXR/PPM frames complete and pass their original decode checks. [Local acceptance](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53#issuecomment-6003925865), [platform source acceptance](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53#issuecomment-6004184019). These historical results are not current-head executions or a causal speedup measurement.
- Subsequent original full-path Carter/event/map/refinement controls pass at their recorded revisions, including after the shared tracer initialization repair. [Recorded full-path result](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53#issuecomment-6101975905).
- At current 4bcd987, all ten original named `polarised_transport_to_film` witnesses are covered on the same current primary GCC producers: seven newly executed cases plus three prior current executions joined by exact producer bytes. [Current scientific result and preserved evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53#issuecomment-6135182302). This is finite coverage of that named dimension, not complete scientific/Mandatory/runtime/release qualification.

- All eleven original E2 operating-model witnesses have finite current-GCC evidence, with the two original refusal controls joined to nine verified current witnesses. [Eleven-witness result](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53#issuecomment-6161745367). The separate ten-witness transport-to-film dimension remains complete; neither result is full scientific qualification.
- Three additional original P4 Page–Thorne controls pass on the current oracle producer with unchanged quadrature, truncated-edge and Newtonian-tail assertions and zero failures/errors/skips. [Current Page–Thorne result and preserved evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53#issuecomment-6167434397). The default-edge reference shares production ISCO; its independence concerns flux integration conditional on that edge.

CPU/Vulkan symmetry requires complete ownership at the same input/state and consumer join. The recorded Vulkan stage-seven point identity does not make Transport's RHS roots a complete Endpoint geometry/inverse-dot-momentum owner. Existing Endpoint prefix/suffix ownership remains connected; no incomplete cache may replace required physical arithmetic. The bounded point evidence is preserved under `attestations/software-vulkan/b5d2abf/stage-seven-endpoint-point-identity`. Detailed source/raw identities remain in the existing comments, Git tags and local ignored attestations.

Remaining acceptance: complete applicable integrated Mandatory/runtime/platform/release qualification and practical-performance obligations on the final exact clean revision, preserving every original ownership, conservation, event, beam, numerical and writer criterion. Complete the applicable original CPU scientific integration and required scientific estate with zero failures/errors/skips; retain original independent references and settings. Reuse unaffected historical evidence only within its source and execution bounds. Full scientific/release and governed native scene/viewer qualification remain dependencies of [#48](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/48) and [#44](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/44). Current qualification is 2/8 build-only domains, six pending and readiness/release false. Keep this issue open until those applicable acceptance conditions are met.
